services.title: ISO 27001:2022 Certification
services.summary: End-to-end ISMS design, Annex A control implementation, risk treatment plans, internal audits, and external certification support.
deliverables: Comprehensive ISO 27001:2022 Gap Assessment Report
Information Security Policy Suite & SOPs (93 Annex A Controls)
Asset Inventory, Risk Register & Statement of Applicability (SoA)
Employee Security Awareness Training & Records
Pre-Certification Internal Audit & Management Review Minutes
Stage 1 & Stage 2 External Certification Body Audit Support

faqs.q: How long does it take to get ISO 27001:2022 certified?
faqs.a: With our structured 6-stage implementation methodology, most startups and mid-sized enterprises achieve full audit readiness within 6 to 10 weeks.

faqs.q: Do you help with migrating from ISO 27001:2013 to 2022?
faqs.a: Yes, we handle full transition gap assessments, updated Annex A threat intelligence controls, and recertification audits.

faqs.q: Should we start with SOC 2 Type I or go straight to Type II?
faqs.a: SOC 2 Type I validates control design at a point in time (4–6 weeks) to unblock immediate enterprise deals, followed by a 3-to-6-month Type II observation window.

faqs.q: Can you work alongside Vanta, Drata, or Sprinto?
faqs.a: Yes, our lead auditors configure, tune, and map custom controls directly inside your compliance automation platform.

faqs.q: What are the key requirements under India’s DPDP Act?
faqs.a: Organizations acting as Data Fiduciaries must implement verifiable consent notices, purpose limitation, reasonable security safeguards, and prompt breach reporting.

subServices.title: Web Application VAPT

faqs.q: Is a confirmatory re-test included after we patch the findings?
faqs.a: Yes, one full confirmatory re-test and updated Safe-to-Host attestation certificate are included at no extra cost.

subServices.title: Android Application VAPT

deliverables: APK Decompilation, Smali Analysis & Hardcoded Secret Discovery
SSL Pinning, Root Detection & Anti-Tampering Bypass Testing
Frida & Objection Runtime Memory Instrumentation Audit
Insecure SharedPreferences, SQLite, Keystore & IPC Component Checks
Backend API Communication & Deep-Link Exploitation Analysis
Remediation Report & Confirmatory Re-Testing

faqs.q: Do you test both rooted and non-rooted scenarios?
faqs.a: Yes, we bypass root detection and SSL pinning via Frida to inspect runtime memory, local storage, and encrypted API traffic.
